issues.title: [Bug]: string:indexOf/includes find the empty string when startIndex is past the end
issues.reasoning: Reproduces on main (prints 3/false/true/false). The lang.string docs say indexOf returns the first occurrence >= startIndex or (), and includes returns true only for an occurrence at an index >= startIndex. The empty string occurs in "abc" only at 0..3, so startIndex 4 or 100 must give () and false. The subagent judged it a bug. The fix is in the lang.string implementation.

issues.title: [Bug]: while true loop without break does not narrow to never for type narrowing
issues.output:

 --> 1540.bal:9:16
  |
9 |     string s = x;
  |                ^

ballerina: compilation contains errors
issues.reasoning: Reproduces: 'expected string, got int|string' at `string s = x;`. Under §7.12/§7.22.2, `while true` with no break cannot complete normally, so that branch contributes never and x narrows to string after the if. The type checker rejects a valid program. The subagent judged it a bug. Related to #1539 (never narrowing) but a different mechanism (completion analysis), so not a duplicate.

issues.title: [Bug]: computed-name fields in a map constructor are not added after the other fields
issues.reasoning: Reproduces: prints ["b","a","c"]. §6.7.2 says computed-name fields are added after all other fields when the inherent type is a map, so the expected order is a,c,b. The BIR (`newMap {| int... |}{[k]=%3, %4=%5, %6=%7}`) keeps the computed entry marked, so the runtime newMap can apply the ordering. Classified backend, consistent with related #1470 (computed-name field override, labelled runtime). It could also be fixed by reordering in desugar/BIR gen. The subagent judged it a bug.

issues.title: [Bug]: error constructor accepts named args not declared in the detail record
issues.reasoning: Reproduces: compiles and prints error("open",extra=true). §6.17: every named arg must name an individual field of the detail record, unless it has none. OpenDetail declares `count`, so `extra` must be a compile error. The subagent judged it a bug. Missing semantic check.

issues.title: [Bug]: action nested inside an expression is accepted
issues.reasoning: Reproduces: compiles and prints 2. §7.1: an action cannot be nested inside an expression. `( action-or-expr )` is not an expression, so `(<int> checkpanic wait f) + 1` must be rejected. The subagent judged it a bug. Missing semantic/syntactic check. Related: #1244 (start action in cast/select), which is the converse case (valid positions crash).

issues.title: [Bug]: type cast does not give its operand the cast type as expected type
issues.reasoning: Reproduces, and is worse than reported: current main prints -9.223372036854776e18 (the issue says 9.22e18). Spec type cast: the operand's expected type is the intersection with the cast type (float). So the literal is a float literal, 1e20. The type checker does not pass the cast type as the expected type for literal typing. The subagent judged it a bug.
